subject: Next steps and scope confirmation — Greenfield technical deep dive
messages:
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
To: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@greenfieldretail.com>, Tom Weber <tom.weber@greenfieldretail.com>
Cc: procurement@greenfieldretail.com
Date: Tue, 20 Jun 2027 14:05:00 +0000
Subject: Next steps and scope confirmation — Greenfield technical deep dive

Hi Lena & Tom,

Thanks again for the 30-minute discovery today — super helpful to understand your multi-region latency targets and the residency questions for customer PII. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we're aligned: 

- Primary goals from your side: evaluate inference latency at 99th pct, understand data residency options (EU vs US), and confirm integration path for SSO + API tokens.
- Suggested scope for the technical deep dive: architecture walkthrough, SSO test flow, sample throughput test (100 qps), and a short Q&A on SOC2 controls and data retention.

Would like to schedule a 60-minute technical deep dive where we can bring our product engineer and security lead. Two candidate slots (all PT):
- Wed, Jun 22 — 10:00–11:00 PT
- Thu, Jun 23 — 08:00–09:00 PT

Could you confirm which slot works and who from your side should join? From our side I'd propose: myself (AE), Marissa Cole (Customer Success), Sergio Alvarez (Product Engineer), and Dev Patel (Security/Compliance). If there are other attendees — security, procurement, or platform — please list them so we can adjust the agenda.

I've attached a one-pager post-call notes and a draft agenda to help with invites (GF-postcall-notes.txt attached).

Next steps:
1) Confirm slot and attendees
2) Share any pre-reqs (SSO test account, sample payloads)
3) We'll send a calendar invite + short agenda

Thanks — look forward to locking this in.

Best,
Evelyn
Evelyn Hart
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
E: evelyn.hart@redwood.com
T: +1 (415) 555-0199

Perfect — locking in Wed, Jun 22 10:00–11:00 PT. Thanks for confirming, Lena.

Agenda (draft) — 60-minute technical deep dive
1) 10:00–10:10 — Introductions & success criteria (Evelyn / Lena)
2) 10:10–10:25 — Architecture and deployment options (Sergio)
3) 10:25–10:35 — SSO integration flow & pre-reqs (Sergio + Tom)
4) 10:35–10:45 — Throughput and latency expectations + sample test plan (Sergio)
5) 10:45–10:55 — Security / compliance Q&A (Dev)
6) 10:55–11:00 — Next steps and action items (Evelyn / Marissa)

Action items for Greenfield before the call:
- Share an SSO test user or a details doc (IdP type, SAML/OIDC)
- Any allowlist ranges for network tests
- A brief list of sample payloads you want us to run (JSON/size)

@Sergio — can you add a 2-slide appendix (SSO flow + brief perf test config) to the agenda and confirm if you need a test account or any environment variables ahead of time?
@Dev — we'll expect a couple of compliance questions; attaching a short SOC2 evidence checklist for reference (SOC2-evidence-list.xlsx).

I'll send the calendar invite and include the agenda + slides. Marissa will join to capture action items and next steps.

Thanks all — looking forward to it.

Best,
Evelyn

Thanks — quick internal note before we send final agenda.

Evelyn / Marissa,
- I can cover architecture + SSO flow + perf test plan. I'll prepare a 2-slide appendix and a short runbook for the 100 qps sample run.
- For the throughput test I'll need: an SSO test user (or a pass-through if they prefer token auth), sample payload (typical size & tokens), and any egress allowlists for our test host.
- Dev: can you confirm whether the SOC2 checklist we attached needs anything else (data purge confirmation, log retention window)?

Attachments: SOC2-evidence-list.xlsx

I'll also draft a minimal test plan (30–40 queries/sec ramp to 100 qps, 10 minute steady-state) and include expected metrics to capture (p50/p95/p99 latencies, CPU/GPU utilization).

If that looks good I'll push the agenda + slide deck to Evelyn and send the invite to Greenfield.

— Sergio
Product Engineer | Redwood Inference
sergio.alvarez@redwood.com
